$comment: Canonical types shared by every cluster. Source: docs/clusters/README.Clusters.md, 'Canonical Types & Access Classes' and the 'FAULT <TYPE> Registry'. Only the scalars this slice uses are listed.

hz.$comment: float32 in the docs; carried as hundredths of a hertz (1.00 Hz = 100), written with two decimals on the wire.

BitVector.$comment: docs/bindings/Cpp.md: up to 32 channels. The one source of the width: attributes marked "channels": "BitVector" are bounded by it, and codeline/appliance/IControl.h's BitVector::kMaxCount is checked against the generated kBitVectorWidth.

FaultType.$comment: Registry order. Each value names the cluster that declares it.

ColorName.$comment: The named colors of a ColorValue: Cluster:COLOR color.palette plus NONE (dark), spelled as in MQTT.md section 2. Used by the IMastDriver port for per-head aspects.
